question: Give me the count of populated places by feature class within the bounding box from longitude -10 to 30 and latitude 35 to 60.
sql:
WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-10, 35, 30, 60) AS geom
)
SELECT p.feature_class, COUNT(*) AS place_count
FROM populated_places p, region r
WHERE ST_Within(p.geometry, r.geom)
GROUP BY p.feature_class
ORDER BY place_count DESC, p.feature_class;

question: List the top 5 countries by total maximum population of world cities within the bounding box from longitude 100 to 145 and latitude 20 to 50.
sql:
WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(100, 20, 145, 50) AS geom
)
SELECT p.country, SUM(p.pop_max) AS total_pop
FROM populated_places p, region r
WHERE ST_Within(p.geometry, r.geom) AND p.is_world_city = true
GROUP BY p.country
ORDER BY total_pop DESC, p.country
LIMIT 5;

question: Compare the number of capital and non-capital populated places within the bounding box from longitude -85 to -35 and latitude -55 to 15.
sql:
WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-85, -55, -35, 15) AS geom
)
SELECT p.is_capital, COUNT(*) AS place_count
FROM populated_places p, region r
WHERE ST_Within(p.geometry, r.geom)
GROUP BY p.is_capital
ORDER BY p.is_capital;

question: Give me the count of populated places within 200 km of Frankfurt, grouped by feature class.
sql:
WITH center AS (
  SELECT ST_Point(8.675, 50.1) AS geom
)
SELECT p.feature_class, COUNT(*) AS place_count
FROM populated_places p, center c
WHERE ST_DWithin_Spheroid(p.geometry, c.geom, 200000)
GROUP BY p.feature_class
ORDER BY place_count DESC, p.feature_class;
